items.title: ICv2 White Paper 2026 - Building On Growth
items.summary: Features the charts and graphs that show the state of the comics and graphic novel market in all its channels.  This year, Milton Griepp presents his annual White Paper that highlights trends that have implications for the Future of Fandom, the 2026 theme of the Talks.  Originally presented at New York Comic Con, October 8, 2026.
